title: MODAVIS VAO Importer for Unity
description: Unity Package Manager plugin for offline validation and selective import of Virtual Acoustic Object 0.4.0 carriers and a pinned 0.5.0 candidate, including typed scientific observations, physical signal mappings, deterministic execution, MIDI/XR integration, and position-aware RIR/SOFA rendering.

creators.name: Ukolov, Dominik
creators.affiliation: Digital Humanities (Image/Object), Friedrich Schiller University Jena; Research Group DIGITAL ORGANOLOGY, Leipzig University
